svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Mockup 12: A simpler admin
svg.text: 12 · A simpler admin: no browser dialogs, undo where a change is easy to regret, find a page by name (organiser)
Use case: an organiser removes the café zone on a phone during set-up. U12, L9, L10; the N1 checklist of the inventory summary.
A · Today: the browser's dialog
B · A confirm in the page, saying what goes

g.text: Its screen (Café bar) moves to no zone and shows
the event's welcome until you assign it.
Its layout, schedule and 3 pins are deleted. This

svg.text: C · Easy to regret: done at once, with Undo
D · Find a page or a setting by name
The pass starts with an audit (U12)
Every organiser page against one checklist, a screenshot
and a finding each, like the step 3 audit; the lead picks the
fixes in the session.
Confirm says what is lost (L9)
Only for what cannot be undone, in the page, never the
browser's dialog; the danger button names the thing.
Undo for the rest (L9, N6)
Removing an item, turning a screen off, unpinning: done at
once, Undo for 10 s; the audit log keeps both.
Find by name (L10)
Pages and declared settings in this step; '/' focuses it.
Screens, people and items need each module's search read
(later).
